rows: Birth to cessation of rapid growth (~6–9 mo, varying with breed and size)
Cessation of rapid growth to completion of physical and social maturation, which occurs in most dogs by 3 to 4 yr of age
Completion of physical and social maturation until the last 25% of estimated lifespan (breed and size dependent)
The last 25% of estimated lifespan through end of life
Terminal stage (depends on the specific pathologies)
